label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from query string flows directly to printf() format string sink without effective mitigation. The doSomething() method's array manipulation (removing index 0, getting index 1) does not protect against format string injection since the decoded param still reaches printf() as the format string argument.

evidence.note: User input extracted from query string and URL-decoded
printf() called with decoded param as format string argument - enables format string attack
